mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 60 degrees and an air quality index of 63, which is considered moderate. We also have a full moon out there tonight.

The City Clerk's office has launched a community vote for the I Voted sticker contest. Verona area students submitted 53 original designs, and residents are encouraged to vote online for their favorite sticker in each age category through August 7 to determine what will be used in the November election.

We have a busy day in Verona today. You can stop by the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy lunch at the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher event at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia.
In a report on notable calls, police noted that on Saturday, July 26, an 83 year old woman was cited for an improper left turn and hit and run following a crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.

Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Since the restaurant is currently closed, please note they will reopen at 10 AM today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Caramel Turtle flavor.
